think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether any specific numeric value (e.g., -1 or 0) is documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/enable/auto/sentinel behavior) rather than being just an extreme point on the same scale. 3) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
